restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.name: Gu Refinement
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.descriptio: By default, raise 1 eligible Gu Worm by one rank. After your deck contains a rank-6 Gu Worm, you may select up to 2. Each rest site allows one successful refinement.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.selectionP: Choose Gu Worms to raise by one rank. After reaching rank 6, you may select up to 2.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.name: Gu Fusion
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.description: Choose one or more Gu cards and click Confirm manually. The selection limit is determined by currently craftable recipes. Materials are consumed only when both their types and quantities match a recipe. A failed attempt does not consume the use. Fusion can succeed once per rest site.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.selectionProm: Choose fusion materials, then click Confirm. The required count depends on the recipe.

combatInterfaceLocalizationFallbacks.text: Gu Storage Pile

Stores Gu Worms with activations remaining. Depleted Gu enter the Recovery Pile and use an independent recovery time based on type and rank; some higher-rank Gu create normal derivative cards during recovery. Left-click to inspect; right-click and spend 1 Energy to deduce a Killer Move. On success, also pay twice the average effective Primeval Essence cost of all materials, rounded up. Materials are Exhausted, and the Killer Move enters your hand without counting as a Gu Worm.
There are no Gu Worms available in the Gu Storage Pile.
Choose the next Gu Worm in recipe order. {SelectedCount} selected; after choosing at least one, confirm or go back to finish.
Gu Recovery Pile
Stores depleted Gu Worms. Each Gu Worm recovers independently according to its type and rank; some rank-3 or higher Gu create normal derivative cards when entering or progressing through recovery.
The Gu Recovery Pile is empty.
Brilliance
A character resource capped at 9. Brilliance does not disappear at end of turn; Light Path cards can gain or spend it.
Illumination Break
The next time a single hit from an Attack card deals damage, take 3 additional damage and remove 1 Illumination Break. Multi-hit attacks can consume multiple stacks.
Blood Essence
A personal character resource capped at 12. Only Blood Path Gu cards and their exclusive debuffs can gain or spend Blood Essence.
Blood Mark

After taking unblocked damage from the applier’s Blood Path Gu Attack, remove 1 Blood Mark and lose 3 additional HP. Across the battlefield, each CardPlay grants at most 1 Blood Essence; Replay starts a new CardPlay.
Bleed
At the end of the owner’s turn, remove 1 Bleed, grant the applier 1 Blood Essence, and deal 3 damage to the owner.
Blood Qi Recovery
At the start of your next turn, heal {Amount} HP, then remove this effect.
Primeval Essence
Primeval essence stored in a Gu Master's aperture. Begin combat with 5; from turn 2 onward, restore 2 at the start of each turn. Maximum essence increases with aperture rank, up to 25.
